type T0 = {[K in boolean]: number};
type T<K> = { [P in K]: string };
type U = { [K in "x" as boolean]: number };
type V<K extends string> = { [P in K]: string };
type W = { [P in never]: 1 };
type X = { [P in "a" | 1 | symbol]: 1 };
type Y = { [P in {}]: 1 };
type Z<K extends string> = { [P in K as `x${P}`]: 1 };
type Z2<K> = { [P in keyof K as P]: 1 };
type Z3 = { [P in "a" as {a:1}]: 1 };
type Z4 = { [P in "a" | boolean]: 1 };
type Z5 = { [P in any]: 1 };
type Z6 = { [P in unknown]: 1 };
type Z8<K> = { [P in keyof K]: 1 };
type Z9<K extends PropertyKey> = { [P in K as P]: 1 };
type Z10<K> = { [P in "a" as K]: 1 };
